::: {.obsidian-timesheet}
:::

Record the hours worked each day. Use a table with the date, the
project or client, and the hours.

| Date | Project | Hours |
|------|---------|-------|
| 10 August | Obsidian Platform | 7.5 |
| 11 August | Obsidian Platform | 7.5 |
| 12 August | Client support | 7.5 |
| 13 August | Client support | 7.5 |
| 14 August | Internal | 7.5 |

State any leave or absence in the period. Confirm the total hours
and that the manager has approved the sheet.
